test.name: Spec 0069 manual check 2: keyboard only, sections, close, reopen, minimize, and Settings

expected: Command 1 to 7 select the sections, Command W closes the main window with the notice, Command 0 opens it again and restores it from minimize, and with Settings key Command 2 does nothing until the main window is key again.
actual: Command 1 to 7 made the window title Overview, Instances – 0 instances, Environments, Catalog, Runtimes, Operations – No running operations, and Diagnostics. Command W closed the main window and a second untitled window (the close notice) appeared. Command 0 opened the main window again with the Diagnostics section it had. Command M minimized it and Command 0 brought it back (minimized=false). Command comma opened Settings (General); with it key, View > Instances read disabled and Command 2 changed nothing; after Command 0 returned the main window, Instances was enabled and Command 2 selected it.
steps: on commit 9d19e4a with a clean tree: `cargo xtask build-app` (Debug), a temporary STACKLY_ROOT under the session scratchpad, `target/debug/stacklyd` with that root, and the app started from target/xcode/Build/Products/Debug/Stackly.app with the same STACKLY_ROOT

Claude Code drove the app with a small AX tool (AXUIElement menu bar dump and AXPress on menu items) and, for keys, `osascript` System Events `keystroke` after bringing the app to the front; CGEvent posts to the pid did not reach the app on this Mac, System Events keystrokes did
keys were sent with `osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "1" using {command down}'` one at a time with a 1 second pause, and the window title (AX) was read after each
reviewer: Claude Code (Claude Sonnet 5.5, sub session dev-f69-m2) drove the app; the user has not reviewed this record yet
